Freight that arrives on time

Helio Freight moves full and part truckloads across Central Europe for manufacturers and retailers. With a fleet of 350 trucks, three cross-dock hubs and a team of about 900 people, we handle more than 60,000 shipments a year.

Digital by default

This year we are replacing our legacy transport management system and building a customer portal with live tracking and automated quotes. Our sales team of 25 is expanding into the Nordics and is evaluating tools to prioritise inbound quote requests.
